description.value: A 26-site lakeside campground on a quiet 3 km lake east of Greenwood, best known for stocked rainbow trout fly fishing and flat-water paddling; the 12 km approach off Hwy 3 is mostly paved with the final 1.5 km on gravel.

address.value: Jewel Lake Rd, Kootenay Boundary, BC V0H 1J0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website for Jewel Lake Park confirms an active provincial campground with 26 sites (per OSM capacity tag) in the Okanagan, accessible off Hwy 3 east of Greenwood. The website explicitly states e-bikes are not permitted on trails and must stay on park roads, and the frontcountry camping subpage confirms reservations are accepted through BC Parks. Jewel Lake Resort on the south end of the lake is noted as providing 'basic essentials and boat rentals,' supporting a food/supplies nearby finding.
concerns: OSM phone (+1-250-584-9025) appears to be the local operator (Quality Recreation Ltd.) number; the BC Parks contact page lists a different general number (1-800-689-9025). OSM number could not be confirmed from website content.
OSM email (info@explorebcparks.ca) is the operator's address, not the BC Parks general contact (parkinfo@gov.bc.ca) — both may be valid but the distinction is not clarified on the park page.
No civic address in OSM record; park is accessed via an unnamed gravel road 12 km off Hwy 3 east of Greenwood.
E-bikes explicitly restricted to park roads only — relevant caution for e-bike touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks provincial campground with confirmed online presence, reservations system, and nearby supplies — a legitimate overnight stop for touring cyclists in the Okanagan region.
enrichment_extras.notes: Internet access confirmed absent by OSM tag (internet_access=no); no website mention of showers, potable water, or other specific campground infrastructure details.
